prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one full resolution text-free exercise master, landscape 1536x1024. Image 1 is the canonical athlete identity: preserve exact bald faceless white/light grey anatomical illustration proportions, white trainers, smooth neutral featureless pelvis, visible anatomical legs, fine dark contours. Black background. PREACHER CURL exact catalogue variation: seated on a compact dark charcoal preacher curl bench, both upper arms fully supported on the forward downward sloping pad, armpits at upper pad edge; feet planted. Camera front-side three-quarter so both hands and elbows are visible. Both palms supinated underhand shoulder-width grip on one STRAIGHT rigid barbell with a single small identical black round plate at each end. Master BOTTOM starting pose: elbows only slightly bent, forearms descend forward along same plane as pad, bar held clear of pad bottom, do not hyperextend. Upright stationary torso. Biceps strongest purple, forearms lighter lilac, rest neutral anatomical white. Whole athlete bench feet bar included with margin to permit curl upward. No text arrows panels logos, no shorts underwear seams or genital detail. This is one native frame not a collage.
